text:
The day that comes after Monday is Tuesday.

Rebeccaˆdidˆnotˆmoveˆasˆtheˆsunˆbeganˆitsˆslowˆdescent,ˆcastingˆlong,ˆtwistedˆshadowsˆacrossˆtheˆrockyˆledge.ˆTheˆwindˆshifted,ˆcarryingˆtheˆscentˆofˆsaltˆandˆdecay,ˆaˆsharpˆcontrastˆtoˆthe˂warmthˆofˆthe˂embrace˂she˂missed.˂She˂closed˂her˂eyes,˂letting˂the˂darkness˂behind˂her˂eyelids˂mirror˂the˂void˂in˂her˂chest.˂"Tuesday,"˂she˂whispered,˂the˂word˂torn˂away˂by˂the˂gale˂before˂it˂could˂even˂reach˂the˂sea.˂It˂was˂just˂another˂day˂to˂endure,˂another˂step˂further˂from˂him,˂yet˂another˂echo˂in˂the˂canyon˂of˂her˂silence.˂The˂beast˂below˂roared˂again,˂but˂this˂time,˂it˂sounded˂like˂a˂name˂she˂had˂forgotten˂how˂to˂speak.
